Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Were moving this conversation toward a short PoC to validate performance and switchover paths from our current provider (self-hosted cluster + vendor X). Before we kick off, our infra and security teams want a 60-minute technical deep-dive to review the migration approach, KV/cache behavior, and rollout/recovery runbooks.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 11/16, 10:00 - 11:00
- Wed 11/17, 09:00 - 10:00

If neither works, happy to share a couple more options. I've attached our current infra diagram and a short list of success criteria (attachments: acme-current-diagram.pdf, acme-success-criteria.docx).

Attendees from our side: Sara Hamilton (app lead), infraops@acme.com (ops alias). Please include whoever from your side will own failover/runbook details.

Acme Corp
